easy.name: Easy
easy.description: A junior on call: slow to react, never researches or ranks up, stops at the middle tier.

normal.name: Normal
normal.description: A steady operator: grows the core, researches when rich, ranks up at the compute cap.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: A seasoned SRE: reacts fast and spends sooner, on the same economy as you.

insane.name: Insane
insane.description: Hard, with a bigger budget: earns more from every user than you do.
